# GBSE Company Limited

<!-- TODO: links below are root-relative because GBSE has no confirmed domain
     yet. Prefix them with the official domain once it is registered. -->

> GBSE Company Limited (GBSE Co., Ltd — business registration 0107829897, established May 8, 2017) is a Vietnam-based supplier of equipment and solutions for building services, covering heating and cooling, smart motor controlling, and smart remote-reading measurement instruments. GBSE serves HVAC, hot water, water supply and drainage, and fire fighting applications, and provides maintenance and service for pumps, heat pumps and heat exchangers. The company has 17 employees and operates from Hanoi (registered office in Cau Giay, operating office in Thanh Xuan) and a branch in Ho Chi Minh City (Tan Binh).

Tagline: Confidence to Contribute.

## Product Lines

Catalogue ranges as published on the site:

- [Automatic Control Valve](/products): Neptune pilot operated automatic control valves and anti water hammer / surge anticipation valves, DN40 to DN1600.
- [Control valve HVAC](/products): Danfoss motorized butterfly valves, motorized globe valves, and pressure independent control valves (PICV).
- [Heatpump](/products): air source heat pumps and all-in-one heat pump models.
- [Metering and Measuring](/products): energy meters, flowmeters (DN15–2000), and water meters (single jet, multi jet, bulk).
- [Plate Heat Exchanger](/products): Danfoss Sondex plate heat exchangers.

## Served Market

Vietnam nationwide — projects supplied across the North, South and Central regions.

Focus market: hi/mid-end apartments, office buildings, hotels and resorts, airports, hospitals, and e-factory projects.

Focus application: HVAC, hot water, water supply and drainage, and fire fighting.
